SQL.Strings: select a.id, a.name, to_date(a.reg_time) reg_time, d.name doc_type, a.doc_num, a.address,
a.phone, a.phone_wk, decode(a.access_roof,0,'VAR',1,'YOX') access_roof,  decode(a.signalling,0,'VAR',1,'YOX')signalling, a.receiver_num,
a.eng_time, e.name engineer, a.done_time,  decode(vat,0,'HƏ',1,'YOX')vat, s.name status,
a.doc_type doc_id, a.eng_id, s.id stat_id, phone_mob, decode(a.foreigner,0,'VAR',1,'YOX')foreigner, a.usname
from bb_abonents a, bb_engineers e, doc_types d, bb_statuses s
where ((a.doc_type = d.id) and (a.eng_id = e.id)) and s.id=status
select * from bb_engineers
order by 2
select * from bb_statuses
order by 2
select * from doc_types
order by 2
select c.id, contract_num, card_num, sign_date, abn_id, inst_date,
decode (inst_place, 0, 'Balkon', 1, 'Dam', 'Digər') instplace, serie,
works_num, c.receiver_num, cable_length, amount, amount_eqv, curr_code,
discount, c.eng_id, pack_num, a.name abonent, e.name engineer,
p.name packname, inst_place, acc_id, rest, round(rest,2) rest_r,
lastcalcdate, decode(calcag,0,'Hə',1,'Yox' )calcags, calcag, acc_no, discount_desc,
c.usname, c.updusname, c.upddate, exp_date, p.symb
from bb_contracts c, bb_abonents a, bb_engineers e, bb_packages p, account t
where a.id = c.abn_id and c.eng_id = e.id and pack_num = p.id and t.id=c.acc_id and abn_id = :abn_id
select s.id, contract_id, reg_time, srv_id, s.amount, s.amount_eqv, s.curr_code,
status, done_time, c.name servicename, s.usname, s.updusname, s.upddate, paymethod, s.frm_contrct
from bb_abn_services s, bb_services c, bb_contracts r
where s.srv_id = c.id and contract_id = r.id and contract_id = :contract_id
select valute id, val_name name from avalute
order by 2
select id, name, inst_price, price, deposit from bb_packages
order by 2
select id, name, price from bb_services
order by 2
select id, acc_no name from account where close_dat is null
order by 2
select * from bb_contracts
